tools.name: erisaledger_calculate_form_8881_credit
tools.description: Calculates deterministic IRS Form 8881 Part I (Startup & Contribution) and Part II (Auto-Enrollment) credits across a 5-year window, including retroactive IRC Sec. 6511 amended return recovery and 51-100 employee phase-outs.

tools.name: erisaledger_audit_secure2_census
tools.description: Audits anonymized participant census records for 2026 SECURE 2.0 Sec. 603 mandatory Roth catch-up violations (>$150k prior FICA wages), Sec. 125 500-hour Long-Term Part-Time eligibility omissions, and 402(g)/415(c)/Super Catch-Up limits.

tools.name: erisaledger_evaluate_state_auto_ira
tools.description: Evaluates US State Auto-IRA statutory compliance mandates and per-employee penalty exposure across 15 active state programs.

tools.name: erisaledger_calculate_vfcp_late_deposit
tools.description: Computes DOL Voluntary Fiduciary Correction Program (VFCP) lost earnings at IRC Sec. 6621 underpayment interest rates and IRC Sec. 4975 excise tax avoided on late participant deferral deposits.
